parsers.name: google-maps
parsers.summary: Google Maps businesses of a search or one place: name, rating, review count, website, phone, address, category, place id, reviews link.
parsers.note: US exit; Arabic names may still appear

parsers.name: google-maps-reviews
parsers.urlHint: a Maps place URL, a CID URL, a reviews URL (search.google.com/local/reviews?placeid=...) or the google_reviews_url of a google-maps result
parsers.summary: Reviews of one Google Maps place (up to 1,000): rating, date, text, likes, reviewer, owner reply, link. Optional sort (newest, oldest, relevant, highest, lowest) and limit (1 to 1000, default 100).

parsers.name: google-play
parsers.summary: One Android app: name, developer, rating, downloads, price, version, permissions.

parsers.name: google-play-reviews
parsers.summary: Up to 200 newest reviews of one Android app: author, rating, text, date, thumbs up, app version, developer reply.
parsers.note: US exit; no sort or limit

parsers.name: app-store
parsers.summary: One iOS app: name, developer, rating, price, version, languages.
parsers.note: US exit; the country in the path selects the storefront

parsers.name: app-store-reviews
parsers.summary: Up to 500 recent reviews of one iOS app in one storefront: author, rating, title, text, date, version, helpful votes.

parsers.name: instagram-profile
parsers.summary: A public Instagram profile: name, bio, followers, posts count, category, business address and its 12 latest posts.

parsers.name: instagram-post
parsers.summary: One public Instagram post or reel with its counts and its top comments (about 14; the rest need a login).

parsers.name: instagram-feed
parsers.summary: Top public posts of an Instagram hashtag or keyword (about 12 to 200) or recent posts of a location (15 to 20).
parsers.note: public data, no login; the first page only

parsers.name: tiktok-profile
parsers.summary: A public TikTok profile: name, bio, followers, likes, videos count, verified, category.

parsers.name: tiktok-video
parsers.summary: One TikTok video: caption, hashtags, author, views, likes, comments, shares, saves, music.
parsers.note: public data; short vm.tiktok.com links are not accepted

parsers.name: tiktok-feed
parsers.summary: TikTok videos of a profile, a hashtag or a search, with their counts. The first page only.

parsers.name: tiktok-comments
parsers.summary: The first 20 top-level comments of one TikTok video (use the TREG comments sources for more).
parsers.note: first page only; replies are not included

parsers.name: tiktok-followers
parsers.summary: Up to 30 followers of a TikTok profile (first page).
parsers.note: empty when the profile hides the list

parsers.name: tiktok-following
parsers.summary: Up to 30 accounts a TikTok profile follows (first page).
parsers.note: empty when the profile hides the list

parsers.name: tiktok-user-search
parsers.summary: The top 10 TikTok accounts for a search query: name, bio, followers, likes, verified.

parsers.name: g2-reviews
parsers.summary: The 25 most recent G2 reviews of a software product, optionally filtered by stars.

parsers.name: emails
parsers.urlHint: any public page (a company's own contact page)
parsers.summary: The e-mail addresses written on ONE public page (mailto links and visible text; deduplicated, placeholders removed). It does not crawl: open the company's own site, then its contact page.

parsers.name: phone-numbers
parsers.urlHint: any public page (a company's own contact page)
parsers.summary: The phone numbers on ONE public page (tel links and visible text), normalized to international form. It does not crawl.

parsers.name: links
parsers.summary: The links of ONE public page (url and visible text): use it to find a company's contact page. It does not crawl.

webSources.summary: Web search: title, address and description of up to 10 results (2 credits per 10).
Web search: title, address and description of up to 10 results (1 credit per 10).
One public page as text with its links (1 credit).
One public page as text with its links (1 credit).

Professionals found from a plain-language description (for example VPs of sales at solar companies in California): name, role, company, location, public profile links, 10 per page (10 credits). It returns NO e-mail and NO phone: use it to find people, and a contact source for their e-mails and phones.
webSources.inputs: query (up to 500 characters), country (two letters, optional), cursor (the next_cursor of the previous page)
